title: Principal Consultant, Embedded Systems & Edge AI
description: Are you motivated by shaping how industrial organizations design and scale intelligent embedded systems and edge AI in real-world environments? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution, helping customers move from emerging edge AI concepts to robust, production-ready solutions that transform how industrial products, vehicles, and systems are built and operated? Etteplan is strengthening its Advisory Services capabilities and is now looking for a Principal Consultant, Embedded Systems &amp; Edge AI to join our newly established Advisory team within Software and Embedded Solutions (SES). As Principal Consultant, you lead the conversations that matter most: the early-stage engagements where industrial clients are trying to frame the problem, understand whats feasible, and decide on the way forward. You bring your technical depth to create credibility with architects, and the advisory seniority to earn the trust of C-level executives. Your role As a Principal Consultant, Embedded Systems &amp; Edge AI, you operate at the intersection of industrial domain understanding, embedded software and hardware architectures, and edge AI engineering practices. You lead early-phase engagements, helping customers frame complex challenges, assess feasibility and maturity, and define clear directions for adopting edge AI and next-generation embedded architectures in industrial contexts. You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring continuity from advisory consultancy work into implementation and delivery, collaborating closely with delivery teams and architects. In parallel, you play a key role in building and scaling Etteplans internal embedded and edge AI capabilities, acting as a role model and technical leader across Advisory Services and Business Units. Your main responsibilities include - Leading early-phase client engagements and consultancy related to embedded systems and edge AI, including discovery, framing, feasibility assessment, and direction-setting in industrial environments. - Advising customers on edge AI adoption and embedded architecture modernization, focusing on robustness, scalability, safety, and value creation in real production systems. - Translating industrial challenges into clear embedded product and edge AI problem statements, architectures, and roadmaps. - Supporting sales and pre-sales by providing insight, credibility, and technical leadership in strategic customer discussions. - Contributing to the development and refinement of Etteplans Embedded Systems &amp; Edge AI offerings, methods, and best practices. - Building embedded and edge AI capability across Business Units – acting as a mentor and role model for lead engineers and architects. - Driving an AI-first mindset in how software and embedded systems are designed, developed, and maintained in industrial contexts. What you bring You have deep expertise in embedded systems and edge AI and you know how those concepts need to be adapted when the environment is industrial: reliability matters, safety is non-negotiable, observability is essential, and the edge cases aren't hypothetical. But technical depth alone isnt what makes this role work. What sets the right person apart is the ability to use that depth in client conversations – to listen well, ask the questions that unlock what a client actually needs, and translate complexity into clarity without losing precision. Clear, structured communication style and the ability to operate across executive, architectural, and engineering levels, will help navigate in complex, ambiguous industrial environments. You will thrive here if: - You find early-stage, ambiguous client engagements energizing - You are comfortable discussing with senior stakeholders, and have the courage to challenge in a constructive and evidence-based manner - You think business value first, technology second. An outcome-driven mindset with focus on measurable business and operational impact is what is needed in this role - Youve seen embedded and AI initiatives fail in production and know why – and how to help clients avoid it Experience and background To succeed in this role, you should have: - 10+ years in consulting, advisory, advanced technology, or other senior client-facing roles – with direct experience leading engagements with senior stakeholders, not just supporting teams that do it - Solid foundation in embedded software and/or hardware development and modern software engineering/architecture, combined with a strong understanding of industrial AI requirements – including reliability, observability, safety, and lifecycle management – in hardware-constrained environments - Demonstrated ability to take complex, ambiguous business and engineering challenges and turn them into structured directions - Background in industrial, manufacturing, energy, automotive, defense, or other complex engineering-driven domains - Advisory &amp; consulting capabilities, with strong ability to bridge strategy and execution - Ability to operate comfortably in international and multi-disciplinary environments Depending on your background, succeeding in this role will also require understanding and experience of some of the following: - Direct experience in software-defined vehicle (SDV) architecture, ADAS/autonomous driving systems, or edge AI deployment in industrial, manufacturing, or other complex engineering environments – ideally more than one - Understanding of end-to-end product development processes, concept-to-production, NPD, and how embedded/edge AI components integrate into larger industrial products and systems - Familiarity with relevant standards at architecture or process level, such as functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 26262, ISO 21448/SOTIF), industrial cybersecurity (e.g. IEC 62443), or process/quality frameworks (e.g. ASPICE) - Experience with AI-enabled transformation initiatives, platform and/or product development, or large-scale software modernization Why Etteplan? At Etteplan, you will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, helping shape how intelligence is embedded into industrial products, systems, and development processes. You will join a newly established Advisory team with strong strategic backing and leading consultants in the areas of cyber security, data, enterprise architectures, design &amp; strat

title: OT Cybersecurity Engineer
description: St1 is an energy transition company with the vision to be the leading producer and seller of CO-aware energy. St1 operates in Finland, Sweden, Norway, and the United Kingdom. Our portfolio encompasses oil products, biogas, Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), renewable diesel (HVO) and solar power. St1 has 1,150 retail stations across Finland, Sweden and Norway. Together, were more than 1,000 curious, committed and caring people here to change the game. Ready to challenge the ordinary with us? About the Role St1 is on a mission to be the leading producer and seller of CO2-aware energy. Behind that mission sits real, physical infrastructure: the Gothenburg refinery, fuel terminals, marine bases and depots, a growing retail estate that runs everything from car-wash systems to energy distribution, and UK biofuel operations feeding our Gothenburg biorefinery. All of it depends on Operational Technology, and all of it has to be secure. We are looking for an OT Cybersecurity Engineer to take ownership of cybersecurity across this OT estate. This is a role for someone who is equally at home writing a security standard and sitting at a terminal working through network segmentation, firewall rules, and monitoring coverage. You understand that OT is not IT: long lifecycles, availability comes first, patching windows are scarce, and a security decision can have safety and environmental consequences. Your first mission is clear. You will implement our Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS) across the OT estate, starting with the correct, site-by-site rollout of our Terminal Cybersecurity Architecture. From there, you scale a consistent OT cybersecurity approach across the wider multi-site footprint. How youll help drive the change Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As an OT Cybersecurity Engineer, youll play a key role in Driving the correct, site-by-site rollout of our OT cybersecurity architecture. Setting and maintaining OT security standards aligned to ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443, the CIS 18 Controls, and NIS2 obligations in Finland and Sweden. Working hands-on across the IT infrastructure that supports OT and across OT systems themselves, to the level needed to specify and validate controls, not to run the plant. Guiding and, where needed, firmly challenging OT vendors on cybersecurity. Being the trusted OT security advisor to our CISO, site teams, refinery, and retail operations across the Nordics. What you bring to the team Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have: A proven track record implementing OT cybersecurity, at least at large production-site level, and multi-site experience is a real plus. A genuine mix of governance and technical skill. Strong knowledge of OT-specific constraints and how they differ from IT security. The confidence to challenge vendors and the credibility to make it stick. CISSP or equivalent certification. Fluent English (mandatory); Finnish, Swedish, or Norwegian is preferred. A proactive, can-do mindset and the appetite to work in a lean, fast-moving organisation where you build the structure rather than inherit it. Willingness to travel across the Nordics and the UK. You are comfortable setting direction and standards, then rolling up sleeves to make them real on site. You create structure where sometimes none exists, challenge vendors and assumptions constructively, and prioritize resilience and availability over theoretical completeness. Who are we looking for We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. This Spirit shows up in daily actions: creating a space where it is safe to be yourself and raise problems early, following through when delivery gets tough, thinking end-to-end rather than in silos, and learning faster than the environment changes. Let us know what you can and want to do. Why Join St1? - A high-impact role at the centre of critical energy infrastructure and the energy transition. - Full ownership to shape and mature OT security across St1. - Backed by a strong CISO function and 24/7 SOC/NOC partners. - Security work that protects people, safety, and the environment. - A talented Nordic technology organisation built on trust, freedom, and responsibility How we support your journey At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries. Youll have real ownership of cybersecurity across our operational technology estate, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career. If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site. What to expect after you apply We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process. Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site no later than Thursday, 31 August 2026. Lets challenge the ordinary

title: Specialist, Cyber Assurance
description: Outokumpu is seeking motivated Specialist to join our Cyber Assurance team. In this role, you'll play a crucial part in supporting and strengthening our security controls, while pushing the boundaries of cyber security within our organization. At Outokumpu, we are proud of our global Cyber Security team, which collaborates closely with various departments, including IT, business, to maintain exemplary security policies, frameworks, and controls. Join us to contribute your ideas and expertise in a collaborative environment where you can make a significant impact **What You'll Do:** Develop, update, and enforce information security service continuity and cyber risk management strategies. Assess third party vendors for potential vendors cyber risks and implement contractual cyber agreements with chosen vendors. Monitor and evaluate established vendors in IT and OT against cyber security agreements in place. Take the lead in managing our cyber risks. Identify cyber risks and vulnerabilities through thorough risk assessments and analysis and develop effective corrective actions and remediation plans. Conduct gap analyses to determine the current status of security and risk management and define strategies for security resilience. Recommend and implement robust security controls based on internal standards and industry best practices. Ensure all periodical milestones and control activities are completed and documented promptly. Proactively research new cyber regulations and compliance topics to understand if Outokumpu is impacted or not. Act as a valuable point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders, providing guidance and support to enable the success of other teams and functions. **What We're Looking For:** Basic knowledge of industry-leading Cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001/2, NIST, CIS, as well as privacy regulations like NIS2. Security background with a few years of experience; junior candidates welcome. Eagerness to learn and expand expertise in IT, OT, and IoT security domains. Ability to take ownership and effectively implement ideas. Experience in cross-organizational projects and stakeholder management. Proficiency in thriving within a multicultural matrix organization. Excellent English communication skills; additional languages are a plus. Self-motivated, capable of working independently and collaboratively. Cybersecurity certifications like CISM, CRISC and CISSP are advantageous. **What We Offer:** A challenging and rewarding job in an international environment, where you'll play a vital role in securing critical infrastructure. Continuous skill development and professional satisfaction through our commitment to your growth. The autonomy and trust to take responsibility, be proactive, and work independently. Educational programs to expand your skills and knowledge, ensuring you stay at the forefront of the field. The chance to contribute to sustainable work that will impact generations to come. You'll be based in one of our main hubs in Europe, reporting to our Cyber Risk Manager. Limited travel may be required based on job requirements. For more information about the position, please, contact our Cyber Assurance manager – Harri Seppälä via harri.seppala(at) outokumpu.com , or for more information about the status of your application or help to apply: Talent Acquisition Partner – miikka.enbuske(at) Outokumpu.com To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter in English till the 6th of September 2026. The position might be filled before the final application date, thus, please do not hesitate to apply earlier! The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment

title: Cybersecurity Lead, Colosseum Dental Group
description: WE ARE HIRING CYBERSECURITY LEAD ABOUT COLOSSEUM DENTAL GROUP Colosseum Group is one of Europes leading multi-site healthcare services groups, operating across 11 countries with over 650 clinics and over 12500+ colleagues. Headquartered in Zurich and backed by a long-term family office investor, the group is in an exciting phase of growth, expansion via M&A and transformation. The group has a strong presence in markets including the Nordics, Germany, and Switzerland, with a growing reputation for clinical excellence and patient-centric care, serving over 6 million patients a year. THE ROLE As Cybersecurity lead, you are the owner of cybersecurity across the entire Colosseum Dental group. You set direction, manage risk, and are equally comfortable getting hands-on with the system to actively support our Country IT managers in execution, while representing Cybersecurity to our Board and Country senior management. You will report directly to the Group Director Technology & IT Operations and work alongside the Group CIO, country IT Managers and external partners. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance Develop, own, and continuously mature the CDG cybersecurity strategy, aligned to the Colosseum strategy and the ISO 27001 / NIST CSF frameworks Define and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and baselines across all 11 operating countries Own the cybersecurity risk register; present risk posture and remediation roadmaps to the Group CFO, Group CIO and executive leadership Lead annual assessments, continuous penetration tests and manage any statutory or regulatory obligations (NIS2, GDPR cybersecurity provisions) Own the third-party / supplier cybersecurity assessment process for our technology vendors and SaaS solutions Hands-On Cybersecurity Operations Run a structured vulnerability management programme Personally configure, tune, and audit cybersecurity controls across our Cybersecurity stack (SentinelOne, Microsoft security stack, Entra ID and more) Maintain and continuously improve secure baselines (CIS Benchmarks / Microsoft security Baselines) for Windows, Azure Landing Zones, and M365 tenants Drive Zero Trust adoption across identity, device, network, and data layers Incident Response & Crisis Management Own and together with Country IT Management lead the IT incident response process end-to-end, from detection through containment, eradication, and post-incident review Maintain and test an up-to-date Incident Response Plan and Business Continuity provisions for cyber events Coordinate and supervise the external CDC partner; define SLAs, runbooks, review alert quality, and escalation thresholds Culture & Enablement Build and sustain a cybersecurity-aware culture: design and run targeted awareness campaigns, phishing simulations, and role-based training Act as a trusted advisor to country CFOs and country IT Managers, making cybersecurity understandable and actionable Help grow the cybersecurity capability within the broader Group IT team to make cybersecurity a habit WHAT YOU BRING Non-negotiable 5+ years of hands-on information- and cybersecurity experience, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role Technical expert in the Microsoft security stack (Defender, Azure, Entra ID, M365, etc.) Experience managing XDR solutions, preferably SentinelOne, in a large environment of 5,000+ users Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and practical implementation Led or co-led real cyber incident responses Proficient in cybersecurity frameworks and regulations like NIS2 directive, ISO 27001, NIST CSF or CIS Controls Strongly preferred Experience in multi-country/multi-entity organisations, ideally with a distributed IT model Experience managing or overseeing a CDC relationship Background in healthcare, dental, or a regulated industry (advantageous but not required) Relevant and preferred certifications: SC-100 (Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect), SC-200, SC-300, SC-400, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor You as a person Hands-on, self-sufficient and a pragmatic risk thinker Practical approach in establishing robust controls rather than merely creating compliance frameworks Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-scaling organisation Collaborative and direct to influence without authority across country IT teams Capable of clearly communicating risk to non-technical senior stakeholders WHAT WE OFFER A part in one of Europes leading and fastest-growing dental care groups An opportunity to grow and build a mature cybersecurity function across 11 countries and have an effect on the tooling we are going to use A modern technology environment with an appetite for cybersecurity investment Competitive compensation commensurate with seniority and market and opportunities for professional development A purpose-driven organisation: Our mission is to provide modern, quality dentistry services for the benefit of patients, dentists, colleagues and shareholders, striving for continuous growth and excellence HOW TO APPLY? Please submit your CV and a short cover letter describing your relevant experience and certifications. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage early submissions. FOR FURTHER INFORMATION Petteri Pasanen Group Director, Technology & IT Operations petteri.pasanen@colosseumdental.com [ petteri.pasanen@colosseumdental.com ] Any questions on your mind regarding the position or the process? Reach out to me anytime via email. Please note: we don't process any applications via email, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment portal. Colosseum Dental Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Lead Architect - Operations Solutions Finland
description: **We are looking for an experienced Lead Architect** to join our team and take responsibility for designing and developing business-critical solutions that drive operational excellence and support our strategic goals. **As a Lead Architect**, you will be responsible for designing and governing solution architectures that align with business objectives, enterprise architecture principles, and IT security standards. You will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business and technology, translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced architect who enjoys working in complex environments, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and influencing technology decisions that have a real impact on the business. **Key Responsibilities** - Design and guide solution architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture principles and standards. - Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to understand and define business requirements. - Evaluate, select, and provide direction on technology solutions and architectural approaches. - Support development and implementation teams, ensuring technical quality throughout the entire solution lifecycle. - Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and cost-efficient. - Drive compliance with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and governance requirements. - Provide architectural leadership and contribute to the continuous evolution of architecture practices and standards. **What We Are Looking For** - A masters degree in a relevant field, combined with strong practical experience in solution or enterprise architecture. - Broad technical expertise across applications, integrations, infrastructure, and data platforms. - Strong ability to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. - Experience working in complex, multi-vendor environments. - A collaborative mindset with the ability to influence and guide teams across organizational boundaries. **What We Offer** - Make an Impact on a Sustainable Future - A Key Role in a Global Industrial Environment - Meaningful and Business-Critical Systems - Diverse Technology Landscape - Extensive Stakeholder Collaboration - Opportunities to Grow and Influence - A Stable and Values-Driven Employer **This position is based in Tornio, Finland** Ready to help build the digital foundation for sustainable stainless-steel production? For more information, please contact Emilia Vainio, Head of Operations Solutions Finland, emilia.vainio@outokumpu.com or tel. +358 40 843 9524.

title: Senior Software Developer (Accounting Software Platform)
company: Infinity Consumer Services and Consultancy Provider
description: Infinity Consumer Services and Consultancy Provider is seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer to lead the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our accounting software platform. This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of a growing financial technology platform. **Key Responsibilities:** - Design, develop, and maintain accounting software applications - Lead the development of web, Android, and iOS solutions - Improve system architecture, performance, and scalability - Implement security best practices and data protection measures - Integrate APIs, payment systems, and third-party services - Troubleshoot and resolve software issues - Mentor junior developers and interns - Collaborate with management to define technical roadmaps and product features **Requirements:** - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field - Minimum 5 years of software development experience - Strong experience with modern programming languages and frameworks - Experience with cloud technologies, databases, and API development - Knowledge of cybersecurity and secure software development practices - Experience in mobile application development is an advantage - Strong problem-solving and communication skills - Ability to work independently and lead technical projects **What We Offer:** - Opportunity to lead the development of an innovative accounting software platform - Flexible working arrangements (remote/hybrid) - Competitive compensation based on experience - Professional growth and leadership opportunities - Collaborative and entrepreneurial working environment **How to Apply:** Please submit your CV and cover letter to ** info@inffinity.fi **. title: Solution Expert, Network & Security
description: Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja? Solution Expert, Network & Security Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa. Haemme nyt Solution Expert, Network & Cybersecurity vahvistamaan IT Infrastructure & Technology -kokonaisuuttamme. Tehtävänkuvaus: Solution Expert roolissa pääset työskentelemään tietoliikenteen ja kyberturvallisuuden ytimessä. Osallistut verkkoratkaisujen ylläpitoon ja kehittämiseen sekä varmistat omalta osaltasi yrityksemme digitaalisen toimintaympäristön turvallisuutta ja jatkuvuutta. Teet yhteistyötä IT:n, toimittajien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Rooli sisältää sekä tietoliikenteeseen että kyberturvallisuuteen liittyviä tehtäviä, ja niiden painotusta voidaan tarkentaa valittavan henkilön taustan perusteella. Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat: - Tietoliikenneratkaisujen (LAN, WAN, WLAN, palomuurit) ylläpito ja jatkuva kehittäminen - Kyberturvallisuuden varmistaminen ja kehittäminen yhdessä palveluntarjoajien ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa - Palvelukokonaisuuksien kehityksen ja toteutuksen koordinointi - Toimittajien kehitystyön ohjaaminen sekä operatiivisen toimittajahallinnan tukeminen - Teknisten ratkaisujen dokumentoinnin ja selkeän viestinnän varmistaminen IT:n ja liiketoiminnan välillä Mitä odotamme sinulta: Sinulla on kokemusta tietoliikenteen ja kyberturvallisuuden käytännön ylläpidosta ja ongelmanratkaisusta. Lisäksi ymmärrät toimittajahallintaa ja ulkoistettujen palveluiden toimintamalleja. Toivomme sinulta erityisesti: - Kokemusta LAN- ja WLAN-ratkaisujen ylläpidosta, asennuksesta ja vianselvityksestä - Kokemusta palomuuriratkaisujen ylläpidosta, asennuksesta ja vianselvityksestä - Kokemusta kyberturvallisuuden ratkaisuista ja toimintatavoista, kuten haavoittuvuuksienhallinnasta sekä SOC-palveluista ja niiden käytännöistä Arvostamme myös: - Järjestelmällistä ja ratkaisulähtöistä työskentelyotetta - Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja IT-kokonaisuuksia ja halua kehittää oman vastuualueen ylittäviä yhteisiä toimintamalleja - Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin. Miksi tulla meille töihin? Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta #_msocom_1tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200. Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen. Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä. Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi. Kysyttävää: Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Oskari Raittinen, Head of Department, IT Infrastructure & Technology oskari.raittinen@meyerturku.fi Meyer Turku Meyer Turku Oy rakentaa maailman uudenaikaisimpia ja energiatehokkaimpia risteilyaluksia, autolauttoja ja erikoisaluksia. Osuutemme maailman risteilyalustenrakennusmarkkinoista on yli 10 prosenttia. Suurimpia asiakkaitamme ovat Royal Caribbean ja Rajavartiolaitos. Meyer Turku Oy työllistää yli 2 000 huippuammattilaista Turun telakalla, jossa on rakennettu laivoja vuodesta 1737 alkaen. Meyer Turku Oy:n tytäryhtiöitä ovat Piikkiössä sijaitseva hyttitehdas Piikkio Works Oy, kokonaistoimituksia laivojen yleisiin tiloihin tarjoava Shipbuilding Completion Oy sekä Raumalla sijaitseva laivanrakennus- ja offshore-alan suunnitteluyritys ENGnD Oy. Pyrimme jatkuvasti kestävämpään laivanrakentamiseen. Olemme tunnistaneet viisi YK:n Agenda 2030 -tavoitetta, joihin pystymme toiminnassamme ja yhteistyössämme kumppaneiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa erityisesti vaikuttamaan.

title: AI Agent Developer & Enablement Specialist
description: DO YOU WANT TO SHAPE HOW AI IS USED AT OSTP? AI is transforming how organizations work, make decisions, and create value. At OSTP, we are moving from experimentation to real business impact, and we are now looking for an AI Agent Developer & Enablement Specialist to help lead that journey. In this key role, you will combine technology, innovation, and business development by building AI agents, supporting users, and ensuring that AI is adopted in a secure, responsible, and scalable way across the organization. This is a group-level role that works across all business units and functions, requiring close collaboration and engagement throughout the organization. ABOUT THE ROLE As an AI Agent Developer & Enablement Specialist, you will play a central role in OSTP's digital transformation. You will work closely with business functions to identify opportunities where AI can simplify workflows, save time, and create business value. At the same time, you will help ensure that AI solutions are developed and used according to clear standards for security, data protection, and governance. Your responsibilities will include: * Developing, testing, and deploying AI agents and AI-powered solutions. * Identifying and prioritizing AI use cases together with business stakeholders. * Creating reusable templates, workflows, prompts, and development patterns. * Developing and maintaining OSTP's practical AI governance framework. * Ensuring AI solutions comply with information security, data protection, and responsible AI requirements. * Training, coaching, and supporting users, AI champions, and key stakeholders across the organization. * Collaborating with IT, HR, business teams, and external partners to scale AI adoption in a controlled and sustainable manner. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for someone who is passionate about new technology and enjoys turning ideas into practical solutions. You thrive at the intersection of technology and business and are motivated by helping people work smarter and more efficiently. You likely have experience in one or more of the following areas: * Software development, automation, or IT solutions * Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, or AI agents * Microsoft Power Platform * Microsoft 365 and Copilot solutions * Integrations and data-driven solutions * Business process improvement and digitalization Experience in the following areas is considered an advantage: * Copilot Studio * Power Automate * Azure AI * Dynamics 365 * AI governance, GDPR, or information security * EU AI Act and related regulatory frameworks AS A PERSON You are: * Curious and innovative * Self-driven and proactive * A strong communicator and facilitator * Structured and responsible * Solution-oriented with a strong business mindset * Comfortable both developing solutions and enabling others to succeed with AI WHY OSTP? At OSTP, you will have the opportunity to join us at an exciting stage of our AI journey and play an active role in shaping how AI is used across an international industrial group. You will enjoy significant freedom to drive ideas, develop new solutions, and establish ways of working that create lasting value throughout the organization. This role is ideal for someone who wants to combine technology, innovation, and people while seeing new ideas turn into real business results. MORE INFORMATION The position is based in Jakobstad, Finland or Örnsköldsvik, Sweden, with occasional travel to other OSTP locations as required. For more information, please contact Anders Brännbacka, CIO OSTP Group, +358 50 563 2789. The application period ends on September 6th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may invite candidates for interviews already during the application period, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We are looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering group, focusing on the VIN Decoder platform. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in software development, database design, multi-cloud environments, and in-memory data technologies. You bring deep technical expertise in software development, demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills, and embrace a hands-on, problem-solving mindset to tackle ACV’s most challenging data engineering problems. If you are passionate about solving complex architectural challenges and are equally invested in developing the careers of those around you, this is the perfect opportunity.

title: Staff/Senior Security Engineer - DeFi
description: Staff/Senior Security Engineer - DeFi Globally Remote Ethena Labs – Engineering / Globally Remote / Remote apply for this job Who We Are and What We are Doing: Ethena Labs is actively building and deploying a suite of groundbreaking digital dollar products aiming to upgrade money into the internet era. Our flagship product, USDe, is a synthetic dollar backed by digital assets, and takes the novel approach of using a delta-neutral hedged basis strategy to maintain its peg. This product scaled from zero to $15b in 18 months. Expanding on this, iUSDe is designed specifically for traditional financial institutions, incorporating necessary compliance features to enable them to access the crypto-native rewards our protocol generates, in an institutional-friendly manner. Ethena has also developed USDtb: a fiat backed GENIUS compliant stablecoin in partnership with BlackRock which has scaled to ~$2b. These products are also offered in a whitelabel stablecoin offering where any application, chain, wallet or exchange can launch their own stablecoin on Ethena's back-end infrastructure. Through these offerings, Ethena Labs is not just creating new financial products; we are building the foundational infrastructure for a more open, efficient, and interconnected global financial system. Open job offerings will be focused on two new major product lines coming to market in the next few months. Join us!! The Role We're hiring a Staff/Senior Security Engineer to lead our signing and treasury security program across wallets and custodian accounts. This is a high-impact, mission-critical role at the core of our business. Operating within the security department, you will partner closely with our core DeFi and trading teams to provide an objective security perspective while engineering safe, streamlined operational workflows. Your mission is to own the verification layer between operator intent and signature: independently confirming destination addresses, approvals, and calldata against on-chain truth, never just what a UI displays. The work bridges complex on-chain security with daily operations, securing defensible audit trails, robust infrastructure, and controls built to scale with Ethena's growth. What You’ll Do Own the end-to-end design of our signing regime, including signer composition, thresholds, and intent communication, and continue evolving our pre-signature verification workflows for destination, calldata, and state-change confirmation. Manage, maintain and continuously upgrade canonical address and contract allowlist system and infra that manages it, ensuring every whitelisting or approval action is checked against this list pre-signature, requiring documented review for any additions. Operate and tighten real-time monitoring across wallets, custodians, and DeFi positions, keep it integrated with our SOC 2 incident-response workflows, and contribute to playbooks for evolving risk scenarios. Run independent technical reviews of new protocol integrations and keep our risk register current as positions and dependencies evolve. Continuously verify ERC-20 approval hygiene across the treasury, and partner with Finance on automated reconciliation between on-chain activity and accounting systems. Own the process of producing the documentation of controls, tooling, and decisions that our auditors, underwriters, and institutional counterparties expect. What We’re Looking For Mastery of Solidity and the EVM; you can read arbitrary contracts and raw calldata without assistance. You are fluent in tools such as Tenderly, Foundry-based simulation, and trace analysis. Deep practical experience with Gnosis Safe, Coinbase Prime, Anchorage, and Fireblocks. Strong understanding of the operational failure modes inherent in browser-based custodian extensions and hardware wallet signing flows. Strong practitioner-level knowledge of DeFi protocols like Aave, Morpho, and Stargate. You understand risk parameters, oracle structures, and bridge message-passing mechanics. A security-first mindset that assumes a hostile environment by default. You possess a "vigilance disposition" - you are energized by rigorous verification and are committed to maintaining safety standards even when facing operational pressure. Proven ability to explain technical risks to non-technical stakeholders (COO team, executives, auditors). You are a self-starter comfortable owning infrastructure end-to-end and producing high-quality, audit-grade documentation. Why Ethena Labs? You'd be joining a group that has well established itself as one of the most successful crypto-native company's of all time, a group with a mission to revolutionise decentralised finance and it's position in global finance. Work alongside a passionate and innovative team that values collaboration and creativity. Enjoy a flexible, remote-friendly work environment with established opportunities for personal growth and learning. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u>.</p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p>This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.</p> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - SRE to help us support our highest value Grafana Cloud customers by increasing the reliability of our Cloud databases that are based on Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope. We provide these databases as a SaaS product from AWS, GCP, and Azure across all regions.</p> <p>The SRE team is embedded within the Mimir, Loki, and Tempo squads and focuses on ensuring that Grafana Cloud’s database products deliver exceptional reliability for our highest-SLA customers. In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Partner closely with product engineering squads (embedded model)</li> <li>Own production reliability for high-SLA and complex customer environments</li> <li>Design and implement automation to scale our reliability practices</li> <li>Ensuring our customers meet our SLO targets</li> <li>Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models</li> <li>Proactively reduce SLO burn to prevent repeat incidents</li> <li>Serving as a primary escalation point and on-call for relevant incidents</li> <li>Lead customer-impacting incident response and post-incident reviews</li> <li>Contribute to design docs and code reviews</li> <li>Influence feature design to ensure production scalability and operability</li> <li>Build automation to eliminate toil where needed</li> <li>Improve alert quality and reduce noisy escalations</li> </ul> <p>We seek a staff software engineer operating at the intersection of customer needs, production systems, and product engineering.</p> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro).</p> <h3><strong>What we seek:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years engineering experience, 4+ in SRE/CRE/production engineering. Strong preference for those with formal customer reliability engineering experience.</li> <li>Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).</li> <li>Strong experience with technical leadership, leading a team through projects, mentoring other engineers on the team and serving as a force-multiplier</li> <li>Experience operating multi-tenant systems in production</li> <li>Strong experience designing and implementing SLOs</li> <li>Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. Go, Python, Java, etc)</li> <li>Experience with Linux operating systems internals, and some knowledge of networking, cloud storage, and scaling.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.</li> <li>Experience with calmly and actively participating in blame-free Incident Response, following up on actions, and writing high quality PIRs (Post Incident Reviews, a.k.a. post-mortem documents)</li> <li>Ability to reason about performance, scaling, and failure modes</li> <li>Comfortable working within an engineering team where individuals are encouraged to have a strong sense of autonomy and self-direction.</li> <li>Ability to partner deeply with product engineering teams</li> <li>We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your day-to-day will include:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Regular 1:1s to with your manager and colleagues</li> <li>Reviewing and creating SLOs, proactively investigating ways in which we can further reduce budget burn for those SLOs, which can be self-directed or as the result of learnings from incidents, and may include improvements to monitoring, automation, increasing self-healing, auto-scaling, etc.</li> <li>Improve observability of customers within their environments</li> <li>Designing and implementing solutions to ensure reliability and scalability of our environments can meet rapidly increasing demands</li> <li>Develop fault-tolerant design patterns ensuring that we are considering reliability at all stages of the service lifecycle.</li> <li>Collaborating with our Engineering Leaders to help define and influence product strategy, roadmaps and technical designs</li> <li>Participate in PR review and collaborating with other engineers on their Design Docs</li> <li>Teach others about Site Reliability Engineering and communicate best practices to be applied early in development of new features and functionality</li> <li>Participate in Incident Response when applicable, including investigation through to resolution, PIR, and communication with customers via Bridge calls where necessary</li> </ul> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is €109,709 - €131,651.&nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description: About Linro Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live. We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape. The role You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter. What you will do Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready . Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit. Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run. Support security operations : monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings. Stay close to how the product is actually built . Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side. What we are looking for Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus. Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks. Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level. Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material. Nice to have Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure. Exposure to a compliance automation platform. Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure) How we work We are 100% remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time. What we offer Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market. A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously. The honest version This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast. description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads. This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.   What You'll Be Doing BAU & Platform Stability Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes. Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments. Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes. Kubernetes  Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability. Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management. Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems. Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery. Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health. Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.   What We're Looking For Must-Have Strong interpersonal and communication skills : we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible : roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments Understanding of networking fundamentals Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent) Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state A methodical, security-conscious approach Nice-to-Have Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context) Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator) Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities   The Kind of Person We're After You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool Autonomously drive outcomes : we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next   What We Offer True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution. A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.   We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: About Us Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!) Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh , a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ 125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders. About the Role We are looking for a driven Enterprise Account Executive to join our dynamic and highly-experienced sales team at Socket. In this role, you'll drive our go-to-market strategy by managing the full sales cycle and working to build relationships with Security teams across enterprise organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in shaping the future of our product, selling process and success in the Enterprise market. What You'll Do Meet and exceed revenue targets by working closely with enterprise organizations (>2,000 employees) Security teams. Supplement inbound leads with self-generated outbound strategies for pipeline generation. Develop innovative and repeatable sales strategies to drive opportunities and revenue. Create an unparalleled customer experience throughout the sales life cycle. Manage existing customer relationships to drive renewal and upsell opportunities. Work cross-functionally across our go-to-market team as well as with partner organizations to drive strategic growth opportunities. What You'll Bring 7 plus years of experience in an Enterprise Sales role for B2B SaaS solutions. Experience selling in the cybersecurity (or related) industry. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas. Measurable success in building and managing a qualified pipeline and a self-driven, hunter mindset. An understanding of how to drive success in an early stage, fast-paced environment and take ownership to get the task done. A collaborative mindset and the ability to build meaningful relationships throughout the sales process. Strong written and verbal communication and experience communicating at every level including the C-Suite. An aptitude to take on new projects outside the normal scope of the day to day role as needed. The best candidates for Socket are talented, hard working, competitive, and not afraid to fail. They are team first but willing to take the lead with minimal guidance and supervision. Willingness to travel for customer and company meetings as needed. Our Interview Process Informational call with someone from our Talent team Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager Presentation phase Internal Debrief Final call with our Founder References Decision / Offer We know how important clarity is when looking for a new role, so we've put together a read-me about the Interview Process at Socket. Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer: Market competitive salary bands Meaningful equity program Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage) Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge Paid parental leave Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites At Socket, we Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.
